text:
nina (pm): quick pulse — we need a call on how to roll out the new microtier add-on 'priority-lane' for reserved customers. two options: opt-in migration vs auto-enroll with credits. votes?

diego (revops): opt-in. billing mapping nightmare if we flip everyone. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:

claire (legal): opt-in reduces contract churn. auto-enroll requires written amendment + 30-45d notice. some legacy contracts prohibit unilateral changes.

jon (eng): opt-in also safer for infra. auto would need a compat shim and feature-flag per-tenant. doable but more rollout risk.

tara (customer-success): pilots are split. 2 strategic customers asked for auto because they want immediate throughput uplift. smaller accounts prefer opt-in.

nina (pm): proposal: hybrid path — default opt-in for existing reserved SKUs; allow sales-negotiated auto-enroll for specific pilots with a conversion credit. gating for auto-enroll: must pass performance + billing validation. Thoughts?

diego (revops): hybrid makes sense. propose conversion_credit = min(1 month avg invoice, $7k). also need clear BR mapping: old_sku -> new_addon + billing_code.

claire (legal): okay to allow auto-enroll by mutual agreement only. require amendment template & consent capture. 45-day notice if we change entitlements for cohorts.

jon (eng): add concrete launch metrics:
- canary_traffic_per_region: 5%
- perf_thresholds: p95 latency delta < 7% (no regression)
- accounting_parity: token-usage billing variance < 1% for test windows
Also: 'compat_mode' must support preserve and emulate. preserve = enforce legacy limits; emulate = mirror behavior but account to new metering.

nina (pm): good. also add commercial gating: 2 pilots signed for auto-enroll with SLA clauses and at least one >$30k ARR customer.

tara (customer-success): add rollback playbook item: customer-facing communication template + manual backout steps. I can draft comms.

nina (pm): here's a draft SKU mapping snippet for implementation:

```yaml
# sku conversion map
Reserved-XL:
  addon: priority-lane-microtier
  billing_code: PL-MT-XL
  default_enroll: false
Reserved-L:
  addon: priority-lane-microtier
  billing_code: PL-MT-L
  default_enroll: true  # newer accounts auto-enroll
```

jon (eng): minor ask: make default_enroll an enum (auto, opt_in, negotiated) so we can extend rules. and include telemetry_sampling_pct for heavy tenants.

nina (pm): agreed, we'll change to enum. timeline suggestion: 4w pilot validation, 2w canary, then GA. total 6 weeks. any objections?

diego (revops): acceptable. need billing migration script and invoice preview tooling before canary.

claire (legal): I'll produce amendment template and consent checklist by Friday.

billing-bot: Note: billing reconciliation job scheduled 1767160000 (2026-03-25 11:00 UTC). Expect brief data lag.

tara (customer-success): I'll collect pilot comms and one-pager for CSMs.

nina (pm): action items: @claire amendment, @jon run canary scripts + telemetry dashboard, @diego build invoice-preview & conversion-credit calc, @tara pilot comms. I'll post PR with final gating checklist tomorrow. :+1:

diego (revops): ack.

jon (eng): ack.

claire (legal): ack.

nina (pm): thanks everyone — quick follow-up in #product sync tomorrow.
